text: I absolutely loved it. Love to reinstall the app in the future.
author: Teuntje ;
developer_reply: Thank you so much for your lovely review! We're so glad to hear that you loved using dubbii. We'd absolutely love to welcome you back to the dubclub in the future whenever the time feels right for you. Thank you for being part of our community and for sharing your experience with us. text: I'm not usually one to write a review on an app, but I really think Dubbii deserves one. I got the subscription for a month to just try it out, because why not. Mostly I'm using it for the live sessions and I love it so much. The Dubbii family is amazing and the hosts are very cheerful! Rich and Rox + team; you did a really cool thing.
author: Simone L
developer_reply: This is so lovely to read. Thank you so much for giving dubbii a try and for taking the time to leave a review. We're so glad you've been enjoying the live sessions and feeling part of the dubbii family. Team dubbii.

text: love it. Easy, very helpful and relatable. Its the many steps why i see a mountain to do the dishes, so much fun to do it with these guys.. Thankfull for the big humor in ahdh process you guys bring:, which you need, like x1000 humor, because it all so sucks/hard times, and humor picks you of the floor, laughing cleans up inside/relativity buddy ... Keep going
author: Anita
developer_reply: This is such a lovely review. Thank you so much! And honestly YES - sometimes ADHD makes every task feel like climbing a mountain. Humour really does help make the hard stuff feel a little lighter and less lonely. Team dubbii.

text: Love the focus sessions, the community and the amazing hosts ❤️
author: Eva Z
developer_reply: This is so lovely to hear. Thank you so much for being part of the community, we’re so glad you’ve been loving the focus sessions and hosts. Team dubbii.

text: I downloaded the app right when it came out. Tried the free videos but it didn't really work for me. I forgot about the app until I saw there were live sessions. I thought let's try for a month, what is 5 euro. I'll drink one coffee less this month. And I absolutely love it! I get so much done. The hosts are all so kind, the other Dubbers are amazing! Everyone is so supportive and understanding. Rox and Rich listen to our feedback and keep improving the app that keeps getting better and better!
author: Kelly Hintzen
developer_reply:
Hello!

Thank you for giving the app another shot! We're so happy to hear the live sessions and community made a difference for you. It means a lot to know you're feeling supported and getting things done. We're always listening and working to improve—excited to keep growing with you!

Thanks, Team dubbii.

text: I think this would be a great app. But love to try more than one dubbele before committing to paying for the full app
author: Darjeeling
developer_reply: Hello, Thank you for your review and valuable feedback! We are always striving to make dubbii as good and as accessible as possible. Team dubbii.

text: Very disappointed you need a sub
author: Angela Guichelaar
developer_reply: Hey, thanks for sharing how you feel - we understand it's disappointing that come features need a subscription. We do try to keep the cost as low as possible and still offer free tools like one free body-doubling video. Your feedback really does matter to us. Team dubbii.

text: 1 gratis filmpje en dan moet je betalen. Zonde! Had de nodige filmpjes gratis gemaakt en de rest niet.

text: I downloaded it and started the trial video which looks promising. First think though I noticed is that you can't rewind the video for exam. 10 seconds? Sometimes I missed something she said and I don't want to watch it all over again. Another tip, it doesn't say how long the video is. Would help me. Or is this all available in the paid version? If so, I will get it :)
author: Ayla Mars

text: I love these guys. But ADHD and Autism is a struggle every day! How would I know if this works for me? You show 1 task for free and after that you need to pay and a subscription that is expensive! Most of us needs a body double for a life time... Why don't u let us try out ur app for free for a day before we decide to get subscription? Based on this I could only rate it 2/5 sorry. I would have loved to try it out.
author: Soaphy

text: Thank you so so much! It has made my life with adhd liveable again! I was sooooo frustrated with myself and being unable to keep up with the chores around the house. This app has made a world of difference for me! Thank you so much!

Thanks for trying the app! Remember you can try out your free task as many times as you like. We suggest trying out the full app subscription for a month before committing to a year, and we'll send a nudge to prevent an unexpected auto-renewal!
